apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Fixes short controller taps with immediate touch-down and a 50 ms minimum tap, explicit cancellation/release, and larger A/B/X/Y buttons. Saves live MetalFX changes for the next stream. Adds packet-loss/jitter diagnostics and a launch override for comparing compatible Metal with identical 10-bit 4:4:4 HDR. Frame generation remains removed. 183 parity tests passed, zero failures, one hardware skip; optimized Release build passed. Motion block artifacts remain under investigation. Unsigned build for installer signing.
